nonClaims: No catalog records, formulas, experimental Evidence or GUI changes are shipped by this ledger.
A source abstract verifies the narrow named mechanism, not its detailed equations, viability or universal accuracy.
A source attached to a theory cannot validate every mathematical claim or graph relationship.
ADD means candidate identity supported; NOT source-qualified for immediate live addition.
Candidate year or broad family origin is not inferred from later reviews.
No dark-matter particle detection or favored explanation is asserted.
sourceIntakeLimit: Publisher/arXiv abstracts and review indexes; no original full-text equation-page verification was performed in this pass.

candidates.title: SIMP 3-to-2 thermal-relic mechanism
candidates.reason: Distinct number-changing 3→2 freeze-out rather than conventional 2→2 WIMP annihilation.
candidates.nextGate: primary abstract reviewed; full equation, thermal-history assumptions and locator pending

candidates.title: Elastically Decoupling Relic (ELDER)
candidates.reason: Distinct kinetic-decoupling-controlled thermal relic; not identical to SIMP freeze-out.
candidates.nextGate: primary abstract reviewed; manuscript 2015 versus journal 2016 origin and exact math pending

candidates.title: Galactic superfluid dark matter
candidates.reason: Galactic superfluid phase with phonon-mediated MOND-like phenomenology, not generic fuzzy scalar matter.
candidates.nextGate: primary abstract reviewed; action/normalization and galaxy/cluster assumptions pending

candidates.title: Dipolar gravitationally polarizable dark medium
candidates.reason: Gravitational polarization model within GR; not the same formalism as MOND or TeVeS.
candidates.nextGate: primary abstract reviewed; stress-energy/action and perturbative limits pending

candidates.title: Atomic dark matter
candidates.reason: Hidden-sector U(1) bound-state and dark-radiation cosmology; not a synonym for dark photons.
candidates.nextGate: primary abstract reviewed; equations, dark recombination and DAO links pending

candidates.title: Dark acoustic oscillations
candidates.reason: Distinct coupled DM–dark-radiation structure-formation framework, better represented as a mechanism than a particle species.
candidates.nextGate: primary abstract reviewed; full coupled Boltzmann/fluid equations pending

candidates.title: Warm dark matter cosmology
candidates.reason: Independent free-streaming/structure-suppression model family; existing sterile-neutrino tag is not a substitute.
candidates.nextGate: earliest historical origin unverified; model-dependent transfer functions must not be universalized

candidates.title: Generic axion-like particle dark-matter family
candidates.reason: ALP mass-coupling relation need not obey the QCD axion constraint.
candidates.nextGate: 2018 review is not original axionlike-model source; exact defining Lagrangian review pending

candidates.title: Confining hidden non-Abelian / dark-QCD sectors
candidates.reason: Umbrella model family encompassing dark pions/baryons/glueballs; subtypes need separate granularity decision.
candidates.nextGate: 2026 sources establish current work but not original hidden-confinement origin

candidates.title: Higgs-portal scalar dark matter
candidates.reason: Canonical explicit renormalizable portal benchmark, not equivalent to the generic WIMP umbrella.
candidates.nextGate: locate original singlet model, scalar potential, symmetry and exclusion scope

candidates.title: Inert-doublet dark matter
candidates.reason: Electroweak multi-scalar stable candidate with a different field content from a singlet portal.
candidates.nextGate: primary origin and model-defined symmetry review required

candidates.title: Minimal electroweak multiplet dark matter
candidates.reason: Minimal EW-charge multiplets can be non-supersymmetric and are not all neutralinos.
candidates.nextGate: locate original multiplet construction and loop splittings

candidates.title: Neutralino dark-matter realizations
candidates.reason: Specific SUSY mixed neutral states; subtype/Passport, not a new generic WIMP.
candidates.nextGate: check true SUSY parent ID and original neutralino review

candidates.title: Wino and higgsino dominated relics
candidates.reason: Distinct annihilation/coannihilation and electroweak spectrum within SUSY candidate landscape.
candidates.nextGate: separate from neutralino generic only when detailed source supports granularity

candidates.title: Sneutrino dark matter
candidates.reason: Viability depends on representation, chirality and model assumptions.
candidates.nextGate: primary origin/constraints pending

candidates.title: Gravitino and axino relic candidates
candidates.reason: Superpartners are distinct from axions and generic WIMPs; model-dependent nonthermal scenarios.
candidates.nextGate: separate superWIMP/axino mechanisms after source review

candidates.title: Scotogenic neutrino-mass/dark-matter frameworks
candidates.reason: Dark-sector stabilization can be linked to radiative neutrino masses.
candidates.nextGate: requires Ma 2006 original and follow-on review before identity

candidates.title: Millicharged dark matter
candidates.reason: Small effective electromagnetic charge is not identical to a massive dark photon.
candidates.nextGate: identify charge generation and astrophysical constraints

candidates.title: Hidden-valley sectors
candidates.reason: Model family with rich hidden spectroscopy; umbrella overlap with confining dark QCD.
candidates.nextGate: should not duplicate dark-QCD without clear distinguishing scale/couplings

candidates.title: Mirror matter / mirror dark sectors
candidates.reason: Parity/mirror sectors can host dark constituents but are not just atomic dark matter.
candidates.nextGate: primary origins and cosmological regime pending

candidates.title: Dissipative dark matter and dark disks
candidates.reason: Dark cooling and collapse have distinct dynamics compared with elastic self-interaction.
candidates.nextGate: identify benchmark models and constraints

candidates.title: Ultralight vector-field dark matter
candidates.reason: Vector field condensates and polarizations differ from scalar fuzzy DM.
candidates.nextGate: locate vector dynamics and constraints

candidates.title: Dark baryon / meson / glueball candidates
candidates.reason: Submodels of confined hidden sectors; not automatically three first-class entries.
candidates.nextGate: scope dark-QCD umbrella before splitting

candidates.title: Q-balls, quark nuggets and macroscopic dark objects
candidates.reason: Composite/macroscopic alternatives are not primordial black holes; do not claim equivalent dynamics.
candidates.nextGate: original sources and exact object-class distinctions pending

candidates.title: Boson and axion stars as dark structures
candidates.reason: Gravitational bound structures are not automatically separate dark matter particle hypotheses.
candidates.nextGate: consider structure/phenomenology record rather than theory identity

candidates.title: Coannihilation freeze-out
candidates.reason: Multiple nearby species enter an effective reaction network; existing WIMP Boltzmann card is single species.
candidates.nextGate: consider source-scoped equation/Production mechanism; no automatic new theory

candidates.title: Forbidden-channel freeze-out
candidates.reason: Thermally activated final states can change relic abundance near thresholds.
candidates.nextGate: derive source-specific reaction and regime before entry

candidates.title: Semi-annihilating dark matter
candidates.reason: Number-changing 2→2 reactions with dark matter in both initial and final states; distinct from 3→2 SIMP.
candidates.nextGate: source review and portal assumptions pending

candidates.title: Cannibal 3-to-2 dark-sector thermodynamics
candidates.reason: Sector temperature evolution under number-changing self-reactions differs from visible-bath-coupled SIMP.
candidates.nextGate: source equations needed before separately cataloging

candidates.title: Late decay / superWIMP production
candidates.reason: Parent-particle late decays generate the relic; not universally WIMP freeze-out.
candidates.nextGate: candidate formula/mechanism rather than automatic entity

candidates.title: Gravitational dark-matter production
candidates.reason: Spacetime expansion can produce decoupled relics; source-specific field/vacuum required.
candidates.nextGate: quantization and reheating assumptions pending

candidates.title: Axion field misalignment production
candidates.reason: Source-scoped relic mechanism belongs under existing axion rather than a duplicate theory.
candidates.nextGate: exact reference and equation review to fill linked axion formula gap

candidates.title: Extended primordial-black-hole mass functions
candidates.reason: Distribution and formation-regime variant of existing PBH DM entry.
candidates.nextGate: qualify source assumptions and distinguish radiation era from other mechanisms

candidates.title: NFW dark-matter halo density profile
candidates.reason: Astrophysical empirical/simulation parameterization, not a new fundamental DM particle theory.
candidates.nextGate: add source-located profile to model/formula layer

candidates.title: Einasto and Burkert halo-density profiles
candidates.reason: Comparative halo-fitting functions with different inner profiles.
candidates.nextGate: separate empirical fit from physical particle claim

candidates.title: Standard Halo Model for direct detection
candidates.reason: Nuisance/velocity assumptions used to infer recoil constraints.
candidates.nextGate: source verified model and uncertainties; not a particle identity

candidates.title: Cusp-core / missing satellites / too-big-to-fail
candidates.reason: Tensions and astrophysical systematics are scientific problems, not independent dark-matter theories.
candidates.nextGate: augment dark-matter Problem with discriminators and caveats

candidates.title: Merging-cluster lensing and Bullet Cluster
candidates.reason: Specific lensing/gas offsets are measurements with model assumptions.
candidates.nextGate: dated data and independent sources; avoid general exclusion claims

candidates.title: Lyman-alpha forest small-scale constraints
candidates.reason: Model-converted power-spectrum limits are sensitive to thermal-history and astrophysical nuisance assumptions.
candidates.nextGate: versioned dataset and model scope required

candidates.title: Galaxy rotation-curve scaling relations
candidates.reason: Observational regularities must not be treated as proof of a unique theory.
candidates.nextGate: source and uncertainty provenance needed

candidates.title: Axion/ALP direct search constraints
candidates.reason: Limits are date, detector and coupling dependent, not global statements about axion existence.
candidates.nextGate: per-experiment bound with units and confidence

candidates.title: PBH microlensing, merger, evaporation bounds
candidates.reason: PBH abundance constraints depend on mass function and accretion assumptions.
candidates.nextGate: separate observational channel records

candidates.title: Hot dark matter / relativistic relic cosmology
candidates.reason: Hot relic free-streaming differs from warm/cold classes; verify whether concept belongs to cosmology or neutrino model subtype.
candidates.nextGate: historical origin and exact modeling scope pending

candidates.title: Mixed cold/warm/hot dark-matter components
candidates.reason: Distinct transfer-function mixtures; avoid splitting arbitrary fractions into theories.
candidates.nextGate: model-comparison evidence required

candidates.title: Decaying dark-matter cosmology
candidates.reason: Lifetime-dependent cosmological framework distinct from stable CDM.
candidates.nextGate: original study and constrained decay channels pending

candidates.title: Dark-matter–baryon scattering cosmology
candidates.reason: Interaction with visible matter modifies CMB and structure growth; distinguish from dark-radiation scattering.
candidates.nextGate: source-specific effective interaction needed

candidates.title: Screened modified-gravity phenomenology
candidates.reason: Existing gravity framework may encompass some cases; not all address the dark-matter problem.
candidates.nextGate: do not treat as DM replacement without galaxy/cluster quantitative predictions

candidates.title: Cold dark matter as ΛCDM component
candidates.reason: Cold dark matter is an explicit component of the existing ΛCDM theory; no duplicate entry.
candidates.nextGate: use theory's physical-matter-component field or model link

candidates.title: QCD axion
candidates.reason: Already indexed as axion theory; distinguish broad ALP family.
candidates.nextGate: existing entry is the parent for axion production and constraints

candidates.title: Sterile-neutrino dark matter
candidates.reason: A directly indexed candidate; specific nonresonant/resonant production can be submodels.
candidates.nextGate: avoid duplicate umbrella

candidates.title: Self-interacting dark matter
candidates.reason: Indexed already; velocity-dependent, anisotropic and mediator regimes remain open depth.
candidates.nextGate: source-specific math rather than new base theory

candidates.title: Primordial-black-hole dark matter
candidates.reason: Existing class, with incomplete formation/abundance depth.
candidates.nextGate: extend existing entry

candidates.title: Dark photon / kinetic mixing
candidates.reason: Existing dark-photon entry; vector dark matter not necessarily identical.
candidates.nextGate: keep mediator versus DM composition separate

candidates.title: Freeze-in FIMP production
candidates.reason: Existing freeze-in mechanism with one canonical sourced decay kernel.
candidates.nextGate: extend regimes rather than duplicate

candidates.title: Asymmetric dark matter
candidates.reason: Existing catalogued mechanism.
candidates.nextGate: different asymmetry-generation models may be subtypes

candidates.title: MOND and TeVeS alternatives
candidates.reason: Both have dedicated entries and already qualified mathematics.
candidates.nextGate: do not mislabel them direct evidence against microscopic DM

stages.name: Exact catalog identity and duplicates audit
stages.acceptance: Authoritative names/aliases and candidate dispositions, machine-checked against live main; no runtime mutation.

stages.name: First bounded primary-source scientific additions
stages.acceptance: Review full text and exact equation locators for SIMP, ELDER, atomic/dark-acoustic, superfluid and dipolar; ship only independently qualified records, small separate PRs.

stages.name: Existing model and source depth
stages.acceptance: Axion defining formula and misalignment; WIMP model assumptions; PBH/sterile/fuzzy comparison; no silent change to approved records.

stages.name: Empirical Evidence and discriminators
stages.acceptance: Versioned observational/detector source, bounds with model assumptions and confidence; no speculative claims promoted.

stages.name: Cross-links, graph evidence, and held identities
stages.acceptance: Promote only relation-specific evidence; source-review other held families; release in independently verified slices.
